predictive ASAP7 research view only; not foundry signoff, manufacturability, or an N4 claim. Iso-area rule for this pair (docs/DEEPSEEK_V4_ROM_ARRAY_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md sections 3.5 and 17): area is accelerator die area per node times node count; HBM stacks, package, switch silicon and board are reported beside it and never in the denominator. The rom side is one logical device whose silicon is one wafer, 46,225 mm2 (plan section 3.5, 'Wafer versus array'; docs/WAFER_VERSUS_ARRAY_LATENCY.md; the roofline's wafer_reference_silicon_area_mm2 at batch 1 in results/roofline/n5_vs_b200/analytical.json#design_selection.models[model=DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731].iso_area_by_batch[batch_size=1].array_at_wafer_area). The rom_array side's per-node die area is a graded value: 815 mm2 per node is assumed until DRA-PHY10 (configs/hardware/technology.json reticle.area_mm2, graded published from the Taalas HC1 anchor; plan section 3.5 rule 4), while the deployment's own notes (build/abi3/deepseek-v4-flash-rom-array-32/deployment.json#notes.array_placement) state 13,445,283,840 ROM bytes per node and the die area those bytes imply, 1,109 mm2 at the wafer backend's usable density and 1,533 mm2 at the roofline's N5 array density (plan section 17, 'What the built array is, exactly'), both above one 815 mm2 reticle. The 32-node build therefore holds node count fixed, not area: it is the equal-node CONTROL of this pair, and no ratio read from it is an iso-area ratio. The iso-area array comparator is the reticle count whose silicon is within the 0.02 tolerance of the wafer's (plan section 3.5 rule 2, tolerance from plan section 11), derived from the array's per-node bytes and not from 32 x 815 mm2: at 815 mm2 per die that is about 57 reticle-class dies (plan section 3.5). The roofline's 'array @ wafer area' rows give the analytical comparator the plan reads (plan section 17 quotes the batch-8 row; the batch-1 row is in the same artifact): at batch 1, SRAMKV-array-hybrid-x56-romfill, 56 dies, 45,640 mm2, area_ratio_to_wafer 0.987 (artifact value 0.9873445105462412, quoted here to three decimals) against the 46,225 mm2 wafer-tensor-x1-romfill (results/roofline/n5_vs_b200/analytical.json#design_selection.models[model=DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731].iso_area_by_batch[batch_size=1].array_at_wafer_area), within tolerance; at batch 8, HBMKV-array-hybrid-x116-romfill, 116 dies, 94,540 mm2, area_ratio_to_wafer 1.023 (artifact value 1.0226068144943212, quoted here to three decimals) against the 92,450 mm2 HBMKV-wafer-hybrid-x2-romfill (same artifact, iso_area_by_batch[batch_size=8].array_at_wafer_area), which the roofline selects within 5% (plan section 17) and which is outside the 0.02 tolerance, so it carries a granularity correction under rule 2 before it is read as iso-area. This contract executes at batch 1. These rows are analytical; the executed comparison artifact must carry its own iso_area_ratio and the die-area grade of each side.

blockers.required_action: Produce ROM and HBM accelerator records for all 8,000 prompt tokens through EOS or the governed 256-token bound, each in agreement with the external reference, with identical output.
Execute both the ROM wafer and HBM 32-node accelerator targets for TA-DS-CTX-200K-1; the external oracle alone is not an accelerator pair.

Execute both the ROM wafer and the 32-node ROM array accelerator targets for TA-DS-CTX-200K-1 with identical output; the packaging comparison has no HBM side and the external oracle alone is not an accelerator pair.
Publish separately versioned ASAP7 characterization capabilities for all four targets without erasing their distinct memory technology or topology identities.
Characterize or explicitly source every cluster fabric parameter inside an ASAP7 table; the cluster32 view cannot be borrowed.
Characterize or explicitly source every wafer fabric parameter inside an ASAP7 table; the wafer view cannot be borrowed.
Run both Qwen targets with ASAP7 capability/cost inputs and one matching shared comparison digest, using distinct source-valid target boundaries.
Run the complete DeepSeek wafer and 32-node targets with ASAP7 capability/cost inputs, a matching shared comparison digest, and distinct source-valid target boundaries.
Run the complete DeepSeek ROM wafer and 32-node ROM array targets with ASAP7 capability/cost inputs, a matching shared comparison digest, and distinct source-valid target boundaries.
Bind the deployment graph digest, workload id/digest, shared comparison digest, and target boundary digest into cycle results; request symbols and filenames are insufficient.
Route missing engine families: attention, dma, link, route, selection, state.
Route and characterize the ABI3 control/sequencer plane in ASAP7.
Provide an admissible ASAP7 ROM macro view; bundled FakeRAM is forbidden.
Provide an admissible ASAP7 SRAM macro view; bundled FakeRAM is forbidden.
Characterize the cluster link/switch/endpoint path in the same view.
Characterize tile, stitch, router, and endpoint paths in the same view.
Report full-target area and energy plus a visibly bounded uncertainty treatment; routed block metrics are not target totals.

claim_boundary: ASAP7 is a predictive research PDK and is not tied to a foundry.
The three cases contain no ROM or SRAM macro; bundled ASAP7 FakeRAM collateral is forbidden and unused.
The numeric cases implement signed integer DV only, not OpenTallas target MXFP4 x FP8, FP8 x FP8, BF16, or FP32 arithmetic.

Passing results constrain public digital-cell and routed-wire plausibility only; they do not validate target ROM density, energy, sense margin, power delivery, package, HBM, yield, or manufacturability.
The reported TC model is the ASAP7 library's nominal model condition and has no calibrated error bar against TSMC N7 or N4.
